tldr: Midday batch, Aug 13: Lovable raises $400M at a $13.3B valuation as agentic app-building consolidates into enterprise, and The Information reports Nvidia is building a 1T-parameter Nemotron 4 open model — a direct swing at Kimi K3 and DeepSeek. KnownAgents flags mass vulnerability scans spoofing AI bot user-agents. Hermes ships a HAR-derived API client skill and portable/shareable profiles, while a single RTX PRO 6000 runs DeepSeek V4 Flash 284B + DSpark with ~15-17% faster generation and Liquid AI's 3.1B vision model runs on an iPhone 17.

articles.title: Lovable Raises $400M at $13.3B — AI App-Building Goes Mega
articles.summary: Stockholm's vibe-coding leader doubles valuation from $6.6B to $13.3B. Menlo Ventures + EQT lead; Tencent, Balderton join. 60M projects, ~900M monthly visits, ~2/3 of Fortune 500.

articles.title: Nvidia Is Building a 1-Trillion-Parameter Nemotron 4
articles.summary: Per The Information, Nvidia's next open-weight flagship targets 1T+ params — 2x Nemotron 3 Ultra — could land late fall. A direct swing at Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4 Pro.

articles.title: Attackers Spoof AI Bots to Run Mass Vulnerability Scans
articles.summary: KnownAgents: someone is impersonating ClaudeBot/Googlebot user-agents to probe sites for the credential/config paths AI coding tools use. Check your logs.

articles.title: Hermes Ships HAR-Derived API Client Skill
articles.summary: New official Hermes skill turns a site's network traffic (HAR) into a persistent static API for agents and scripts to reuse forever.

articles.title: Hermes Profiles Now Portable and Shareable
articles.summary: /export saves a full profile as one credential-stripped file (skills, memory, persona, crons, plugins, themes); /import restores it — full agent setups now transferable.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 284B + DSpark on a Single RTX PRO 6000
articles.summary: Benchmark: DSpark gives ~15-17% faster generation on coding workloads; q8_0 KV cache extends 256K→768K context with basically no decode penalty; drafter faster in RAM than VRAM.

articles.title: LFM2.5-VL-3B: Liquid AI's 3.1B Vision Model Runs on an iPhone 17
articles.summary: Liquid AI's ~2GB vision model fits comfortably on a phone — real-world object recognition on-device at 3B scale, no cloud round-trip.

articles.title: Garry Tan Flags ibab Team's Deep AI-Alignment Work
articles.summary: YC's Garry Tan calls new work by @ibab and team on deep alignment of AI with user context 'massively important' — models tuned to you and your context.
